name: zclass_camera_render_world
description: zClass_Camera::RenderWorld invokes frustum-grid world rendering and then overlay-node rendering for the active camera/world pair.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the zClass camera render source-cluster pass.

The smoke exercises RenderWorld through zVideo_sw_RenderFrame with a bounded world grid and no overlay children, so it verifies the call path and frustum traversal surface but not overlay child dispatch with populated lists.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44d240 is a direct wrapper: call zClass_Camera::RenderFrustumGridTiles(world, camera, cameraData), then call zClass_Camera::RenderOverlayNodes(world), then return.

The native software-render-frame smoke reaches zClass_Camera::RenderWorld with a bounded world grid, verifies the frame succeeds after the render-world call, and checks downstream frame-visible state and flush effects.
